entities.name: Bo Levar
entities.description: Interplanar smuggler and planeswalker, formerly the sea captain Crucias, one of Urza's Nine Titans.

entities.name: Nunieve
entities.description: Crucias's daughter, who died of a wasting sickness.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who recruited the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: Planeswalkers recruited by Urza to attack Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Titan whose treachery cost casualties; drained by Urza to power the soul bombs.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Titan who took charge and was destroyed by Urza.

entities.name: Commodore Guff
entities.description: Knew how the Phyrexian Invasion would end.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose Black Cloud of Death threatened the Eliterates.

entities.name: Eliterates
entities.description: Colony of merfolk shielded by Bo Levar.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane destroyed by the soul bombs.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Island destroyed by the Sylex Blast.

events.summary: Crucias's daughter Nunieve dies in his arms.
The Sylex Blast devours Argoth; Crucias's ship is caught in the blast, ending Crucias's tale and starting Bo Levar's.
events.quote: the Sylex Blast devoured the island itself in light.

events.summary: Bo Levar and the Titans capture the caves at Koilos.
events.quote: Bo Levar assaulted and captured the caves at Koilos

events.summary: Urza drains Tevesh Szat to power the soul bombs and later destroys Taysir; the Titans mutiny.
events.quote: Urza used the same failsafe and destroyed Taysir.

events.summary: Levar leads the last Titans to plant the bombs and destroy Phyrexia.
events.quote: Levar led the last titans to plant the bombs and destroy the plane .

events.summary: Bo Levar gives his essence to shield the Eliterates from Yawgmoth's Black Cloud of Death and dies.
events.quote: He gave his life in appreciation of beauty

relations.quote: for the love of his daughter whom he named Nunieve

relations.note: recruited as a Titan, later opposes him
relations.quote: He was recruited by Urza as one of the Nine Titans

relations.note: drained to power the soul bombs
relations.quote: When Urza drained Tevesh Szat to power the soul bombs
Levar used his very essence to cast a spell shielding a small colony of merfolk called the Eliterates
